name: Inman (United States)
description: The "Spirit of Inman" flag: a white hoist panel with INMAN, SC in black running vertically, and a dark blue field with a white crescent and palmetto after the South Carolina flag.
history: Inman is a city in Spartanburg County, South Carolina, part of the Spartanburg metropolitan area. The flag was adopted in 2009 (the Spirit of Inman flag, designed by chamber board member Kyle Settle, was presented in April 2009 and is used by both the city and the Greater Inman Chamber of Commerce, according to Flags of the World).
